offering_description.value: Provides cellular connectivity, SIM management and an IoT software platform that lets businesses connect, monitor and manage devices. Sells mainly to enterprises and device makers, delivered through its own network and platform.

primary_products.value: IoT SIM cards and eSIMs; connectivity management software

primary_services.value: IoT connectivity management; device lifecycle management; professional services

customer_segment.value: B2B: device makers, automotive companies, utilities, healthcare providers, logistics firms

end_markets.value: automotive; healthcare; utilities; asset tracking; logistics; retail

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring platform and connectivity subscriptions for connected devices; transaction or usage fees: fees based on data and connection usage by devices; service fees: professional services for device deployment and integration
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: manages cellular connectivity for connected devices, sold to businesses; software / platform: IoT connectivity management platform, sold to enterprise device programs

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions through carrier network access

specialization.value: niche specialist: IoT connectivity and device management services only

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams selling to large device programs; partners / resellers: channel partners and systems integrators reselling connectivity

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: telecom spectrum and carrier rules, plus data privacy rules such as GDPR
